title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
ingredients: 3 cups sifted Swans Cake Down Flour
instructions: Cream butter, gradually add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. (Beat 10 minutes with electric mixer or longer by hand).
Sift flour with baking powder and salt.
Add eggs one at a time to cream mixture, beating well after each addition.
Add flour mixture alternately with milk and flavorings, beating after each addition until smooth.
Pour batter into 3–9-inch layer pan, lined on bottom with buttered parchment paper.
Cool in pans for 10 minutes then turn out and cool on baking rack. Frost cake with your favorite icing.
story: My mother was a wonderful baker of cakes. My siblings and I would all wait around for the beaters, spatula, and bowls to lick off the remaining cake batter of any cake…yummy. Nothing is wrong with raw eggs in my book.
